d: Anthropic, the company behind Claude, has gone public on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT in one of the biggest IPOs ever. The company has priced its shares at $83 each, valuing Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis. The listing is also a major test for the artificial intelligence boom. Anthropic is growing rapidly, but it is still spending heavily on computing infrastructure and remains loss-making. Going public means investors will now get a much clearer view of its revenue, costs, losses and long-term commitments. The question is simple: can the economics of the AI boom…
